Database._comment: SeedContent loads the prototype's demonstration content into an empty database; production leaves it off and loads real content through the dashboard.

Site._comment: Staging turns on the Basic-auth gate and noindex; BehindProxy turns on X-Forwarded-* handling. Both are set per deployment — see deploy/README.md. Never commit BasicAuth values.

Media._comment: Root empty means wwwroot/media under the content root. On a server, point it outside the deployment folder so a redeploy cannot delete uploaded content.

Email._comment: An empty Host disables real sending and logs instead. User and Password belong in environment variables, never here.

Turnstile._comment: Cloudflare Turnstile on the public registration form. Both keys turn it on; either one empty leaves it off, which is what a developer machine runs. The site key is public and goes into the widget's markup; SecretKey belongs in an environment variable, never here.

_comment: Every deployment sets the AllowedHosts environment variable to its own host names (e.g. triathlon.sa;www.triathlon.sa); '*' is for developer machines only.
